title: NeoRadar map layer
description: A map layer file: datasets/<source>.geojson, where <source> is the manifest mapLayers entry's source and may hold a folder (maps/rmas is datasets/maps/rmas.geojson). A GeoJSON FeatureCollection whose header members name the layer, say where it came from and list its items, the toggleable units Map Edit shows and a profile's map.items names. The header comes BEFORE features in the file: the client reads it with a streaming reader and refuses, with the reason, a file whose features come first. A file whose features carry a uuid must have an items table, and every uuid a feature carries has exactly one row; the client refuses a package holding a layer file with uuids and no table, which is a file built by a neoradar-cli older than the item table. A file with no uuid anywhere (a GIS-drawn layer, zones, msaw, areas) needs no table and lists nothing in Map Edit. Coordinates are EPSG:3857 metres like every other GeoJSON in datasets/.

name.description: The layer's display name, as the vAcc wrote it (a TopSky folder keeps its slash: Release/Delegation Lines). The indexer copies it into the manifest entry it adds; the manifest name wins where the two differ.

origin.description: Where the file came from. Read by the explainer only.

kind.description: sector-file: written by neoradar-cli from the .sct and .ese. topsky-maps: written by neoradar-cli from TopSkyMaps.txt or TopSkyMapsLocal.txt. topsky-areas: datasets/areas.geojson, written by neoradar-cli from TopSkyAreas.txt. authored: written by hand or by another tool, which the converter never overwrites.

file.description: The source file name, without its folder.

version.description: The source's own version string where it has one (TopSky's //VERSION: line).

symbols.description: Symbols this file's points name in their symbol property, each a shape in the systems/shapes.json vocabulary (logical pixels at 100%, origin at the symbol centre, +y down). Written by neoradar-cli from TopSky SYMBOLDEF lines, only the ones the file's points use. A point naming a symbol not held here names a systems/shapes.json shape.

tags.description: Every tag this file's drawings carry, each once, in order: what Map Edit offers to hide or show without reading the features. Written by neoradar-cli; absent when no drawing carries one.

conditions.description: Named conditions that a showWhen in this file reads as "$name", before systems/expressions is looked at. neoradar-cli writes one for each condition that two or more items or drawings share, named when-<uuid> after the first item that uses it; a further shared condition first used by the same item is when-<uuid>-2, -3 and so on, in the order the file first uses them, skipping a number another item's name already holds. A name here that systems/expressions also defines is a finding.

items.description: The item table: one row per uuid the features carry. A row no feature names, and a feature whose uuid has no row, are findings.

crs.description: Tolerated for GIS exporters that write one. Ignored by the client: the coordinates are always EPSG:3857.

features.description: The drawings. Must come after every header member.

tag.description: One category name, lowercased, holding no comma.

uuid.description: The item's identity: what a feature's uuid points at and what a profile's map.items lists. Unique within the file.

name.description: The row label in Map Edit, and for the fix, vor, ndb and airport layers the point name a direct-to and a route resolve against.

order.description: Draw order among the items of map layers, lower drawn first, whichever layer each sits in; drawings of one kind (fills, lines, points) are ordered among themselves. TopSky's LAYER; absent is 1, and TopSky draws its areas at 0.

showWhen.description: A condition over the controller's session that shows the item by itself, which makes it automatic: Map Edit offers Auto, On and Off for it, and a profile row forces it on or, with show off, off. Absent, the item is manual and a profile alone decides, as before. [] always holds, which is TopSky's ACTIVE:1. The keys are the session ones (myPosition, myCallsignEntry, onlinePositions, onlineCallsigns, coveredPositions, arrivalRunways, departureRunways, aupAreas, activeAreas, preActiveAreas, shownItems), read with has and in. A "$name" names an entry of this file's conditions, else an expression of systems/expressions. A condition the client cannot read never shows the item, and .dev package-check says why.

includes.description: Uuids of other items, in any layer, drawn whenever this one is, whatever the profile says of them. TopSky's SCTFILEDATA, resolved by neoradar-cli to the sector-file items it names; a TopSky map in one of the special folders (ARTCC HIGH, ARTCC, ARTCC LOW, GEO, SID, STAR, FREE TEXT) is included by the sector-file item of its name, and OTHER_MAP_ACT:= is included by the map that names it. An item may include items and draw nothing of its own. A uuid no layer holds is a finding.

listed.description: false leaves the item out of Map Edit's list. It still draws when its showWhen, an item including it or a profile row says so. TopSky's HIDDEN, and OVERRIDE_SCT_MAP on the item it names. Absent means listed.

color.description: [r, g, b] or [r, g, b, a], each 0 to 255.

dashArray.description: Dash, gap, dash, gap and so on, in logical pixels, repeated along the line. neoradar-cli writes an even count; an odd count repeats with dashes and gaps swapped.

uuid.description: The item this drawing belongs to; a row of items. A drawing with no uuid is drawn whenever the profile lists nothing, and never under a non-empty list.

text.description: The text drawn at a point whenever the point is drawn. On a point with no text the point's name is its label, drawn when the profile asks.

name.description: The identity of a navaid or airport point, drawn as its label when the profile asks.

lineStyle.description: A line's style, or a polygon's edge: a polygon is outlined only when it carries its own lineStyle, which the layer and system styles then fill in leaf by leaf. On a point with a symbol, the symbol's colour.

fillStyle.description: A polygon's fill. A polygon with no fill colour after the layer and system styles is not filled.

hatch.description: A GDI+ HatchStyle (TopSky COORDPOLY:E0 to E52), drawn in color at its opacity over backgroundColor as GDI+ draws a HatchBrush: an 8x8 pattern repeated from the screen's top-left corner, one pattern pixel a logical pixel. A drawing's own, and an area look's in datasets/areas.geojson. neoradar-cli writes a TopSky fill percentage below 100 as its percent hatch (5 is HatchStyle05Percent, 6; 90 is HatchStyle90Percent, 17). A value outside 0 to 52 fills the polygon plain and is warned about.

backgroundColor.description: The background of a hatched fill (COLOR's third name), under the pattern's empty pixels. Transparent when absent, as TopSky draws it. Without a hatch it draws nothing.

textStyle.description: The style of this point's text, over the layer's own text style.

fontSize.description: The size, in place of the layer's (FONTSIZE:=).

fontScale.description: The layer's size multiplied by this (FONTSIZE:*).

fontSizeDelta.description: The layer's size plus this, which may be negative (FONTSIZE:+ and -).

anchor.description: Which end of the text sits at the point; middle when absent.

baseline.description: Which edge of the text sits at the point; middle when absent.

offset.description: [x, y] in logical pixels, right and down positive.

symbol.description: The symbol drawn at this point: a name in this file's symbols, else a systems/shapes.json shape. Drawn in lineStyle.color, turning with the map.

minPixelsPerNm.description: Not drawn while the view shows fewer logical pixels per nautical mile than this at its centre (TopSky's ZOOM).

maxPixelsPerNm.description: Not drawn while the view shows more logical pixels per nautical mile than this at its centre (TopSky's negative ZOOM).

geodesic.description: false draws a long oblique line as the Mercator chord instead of the great circle.

showWhen.description: A condition over the controller's session that this drawing is also drawn under: the drawing shows while its item does and this holds. TopSky's FILTER_ID and FILTER_CALLSIGN. Read the same way as an item's showWhen, "$name" included. A drawing with no showWhen draws whenever its item does, and one whose condition cannot be read never draws.

tags.description: Categories a profile hides or shows wholesale (map.hideTags, map.showTags), across every layer. TopSky's FILTER_ASR, written lowercased. A drawing with no tags is never hidden or shown by them.

properties.description: additionalProperties is open: the converter keeps what the source said about a drawing (section, icao, region and the like), which the client does not read.
